music.prompt: Late-1960s New York art-studio groove: a hypnotic, repetitive loop of muted electric guitar ostinato over soft brushed drums and a walking bass at about 96 bpm, with a lonely harmonica phrase drifting over the top; mechanical and cyclical like a printing press, each time the loop comes round it adds a layer and grows a little more insistent; no vocals

The same hypnotic guitar-and-harmonica loop speeding up and thickening like a machine running too fast, tape-pulse rhythm, layered and slightly overdriven, rising tension, cut off abruptly at the end; no vocals
